Lending Experience Loans API (1.0.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:

OpenAPI description of the lending-experience loan application resources.

Loan Applications

List loan applications

Returns a limit/offset-paginated collection of loan applications. Results can be filtered by state and other supported query parameters.

Authorizations:
1.0.0_sessionCookie
query Parameters
limit
integer >= 0
Default: 100

Maximum number of records to return. The default is 100.

offset
integer >= 0
Default: 0

Number of records to skip before returning results.

ordering
string
Example: ordering=-created_at

Comma-separated field names used to order results. Prefix a field with a hyphen for descending order. The default order is newest first.

optional_fields
Array of strings

Comma-separated list of optional related fields to include in the response when available.

state
string

Filter loan applications by state. Additional filter fields may be supported; see the API reference for available options.

Responses

TBD deployment URL; the implementation uses an environment-provided host.

https://developer.sba.gov/origination/api/v1/loan-apps/

Collateral Assets

Create collateral assets associated with a lending application.

Create a collateral asset

Creates a collateral asset for a lending application.

Use this operation once for each collateral asset. After the asset is created, use the returned identifier to create any related titled assets, lienholders, and pledger associations.

This operation is part of loan-workflow step 7: Collateral Detail.

Authorizations:
1.0.0_authenticatedSession
Request Body schema: application/json
required
loan_app_id
required
integer

Identifier of the lending application.

collateral_type
required
string

Type of collateral being recorded.

address_id
required
integer or null

Address associated with the collateral.

description
string or null <= 100 characters
gross_value_amount
required
number <double> >= 0

Gross value of the collateral.

liquidation_rate_percent
required
number <double> >= 0

Percentage of gross value expected to be recoverable.

required
(integer or null) or (string or null)

Lender's lien position.

valuation_source
required
string or null

Source used to establish the collateral valuation.

valuation_date
string or null <date>
property_type
string or null
is_acquired_with_loan_or_project_funds
boolean or null
junior_lien_position_acquisition_exception_granted_at
string or null <date>
property_improvement_status
string or null
is_property_leased
boolean or null
seller_name
string or null
purchaser_name
string or null
manufacturer
string or null <= 100 characters
model
string or null <= 100 characters
serial_number
string or null <= 100 characters

string or null <date>

string or null

boolean or null

boolean or null

boolean or null
has_full_marine_insurance
boolean or null

string or null
security_instrument_type
string or null

Titled Assets

Add titled-property information to a collateral asset.

Create titled-asset details

Adds identifying and ownership information for a titled collateral asset, such as a vehicle, vessel, aircraft, or other titled property.

The requested workflow refers to this operation as POST /titled-assets/. The documented API path is /collateral-titled-assets/.

Use the collateral asset identifier returned by POST /collateral-assets/.

This operation is part of loan-workflow step 7: Collateral Detail.

Authorizations:
1.0.0_authenticatedSession

required
collateral_asset_id
required
integer

titled_asset_type

id_str
required
string

Title, registration, or other identifying number.

make
string or null
model
string or null
year
integer or null >= 1900
owner
string or null
name
string or null

Pledgers

Associate a business or person with collateral being pledged.

Associate a person or business with collateral

Creates an association between collateral and the person or business pledging that collateral.

Provide exactly one of loan_app_company_id or loan_app_person_id.

The pledging person or business must belong to the same lending application as the collateral asset.

This operation is part of loan-workflow step 7: Collateral Detail.

Authorizations:
1.0.0_authenticatedSession
Request Body schema: application/json
required
loan_app_collateral_id
required
integer

Identifier of the collateral asset.

loan_app_company_id
integer or null

Business pledging the collateral.

loan_app_person_id
integer or null

Person pledging the collateral.

Responses

Companies

Manage current company profiles.

Search and list company profiles

Returns a paginated collection of current company profiles. Use q to search company names or tax identifiers. Use tax_id to filter by tax identifier. Results may be ordered using the ordering parameter, and optional related information may be requested with optional_fields.

Authorizations:
1.0.0_authenticatedSession
query Parameters
optional_fields
Array of strings

Comma-separated list of optional related fields to include in the response when available.

ordering
string
Example: ordering=-created_at

Comma-separated field names used to order results. Prefix a field with a hyphen for descending order. The default order is newest first.

limit
integer >= 0
Default: 100

Maximum number of records to return. The default is 100.

offset
integer >= 0
Default: 0

Number of records to skip before returning results.

q
string

Case-insensitive search text matched against the company name or tax identifier.

tax_id
string <= 15 characters

Tax identifier used to filter company profiles.

Responses

Approved API server URL to be supplied before publication.

https://developer.sba.gov/origination/api/v1/companies/

Create a company profile

Creates a new current company profile. A company name is required. Existing business and mailing addresses may be associated with the company by supplying their numeric identifiers. The website must be a valid reachable URL, and the tax identifier must be valid for the selected tax identifier type.

Authorizations:
1.0.0_authenticatedSession
header Parameters
X-CSRFToken
string

Anti-CSRF security token required for session-authenticated requests that change data.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
tax_id_type
string
Default: "EIN"
Enum: "EIN" "SSN"

Type of tax identifier supplied for the company.

tax_id
string or null <= 15 characters

Company tax identifier.

name
required
string <= 255 characters

Legal or primary business name.

legal_entity_type
string or null <= 255 characters

Legal structure of the company.

special_ownership_type
string or null <= 255 characters

Special ownership classification, when applicable.

trade_name
string or null <= 255 characters

Trade name or doing-business-as name.

phone_number
string or null

Primary company telephone number.

established_on
string or null <date>

Date on which the company was established.

website
string or null <uri> <= 255 characters

Company website URL.

business_address_id
integer or null <int64>

Numeric identifier of the business address.

mailing_address_id
integer or null <int64>

Numeric identifier of the mailing address.

franchise_id
string or null

Identifier of the associated franchise.

Responses

Approved API server URL to be supplied before publication.

https://developer.sba.gov/origination/api/v1/companies/

Company Employees

Manage people associated with companies.

Search and list company employees

Returns a paginated collection of people associated with companies. Use company_id to retrieve employees associated with a specific company. Use name to search employees by full name. Results may be ordered and paginated.

Authorizations:
1.0.0_authenticatedSession
query Parameters
optional_fields
Array of strings

Comma-separated list of optional related fields to include in the response when available.

ordering
string
Example: ordering=-created_at

Comma-separated field names used to order results. Prefix a field with a hyphen for descending order. The default order is newest first.

limit
integer >= 0
Default: 100

Maximum number of records to return. The default is 100.

offset
integer >= 0
Default: 0

Number of records to skip before returning results.

company_id
integer <int64>

Numeric identifier of the company whose employees should be returned.

name
string

Case-insensitive search text matched against the employee's full name.

Responses

Approved API server URL to be supplied before publication.

https://developer.sba.gov/origination/api/v1/company-employees/

Document Files

Validate, upload, and download document files.

Upload a PDF document

Uploads a PDF file and associates it with an existing loan-application document requirement.

The file must use the application/pdf media type and must not exceed 50 MiB. The file may remain unavailable for download while security scanning is in progress.

Use the document requirement identifier returned by GET /loan-app-docs/.

1.0.0_userSession
Request Body schema: multipart/form-data
required
loan_app_doc_id

integer <int64> >= 1

file

string <binary>

Compliance Checks

Screening results returned by supported compliance services.

List compliance screening results

Returns the latest available compliance screening result for each business or individual and screening source associated with the requested loan application. Without a loan application filter, returns all compliance checks available to the authenticated user.

Authorizations:
1.0.0_authenticatedSession
query Parameters
loan_app_id
integer <int64>

Numeric identifier of the loan application.

loan_app_compliance_check_id
integer <int64>

Numeric identifier of a specific compliance screening result.

limit
integer >= 0
Default: 100

Maximum number of records to return. The default is 100.

offset
integer >= 0
Default: 0

Number of records to skip before returning results.

ordering
string
Example: ordering=-created_at

Comma-separated field names used to order results. Prefix a field with a hyphen for descending order. The default order is newest first.

Responses

Compliance Alerts

List compliance alerts

Returns compliance alerts associated with loan applications available to the authenticated user. Use the loan application filter to retrieve alerts for a specific application. Update the status of a compliance alert

Updates the resolution status of a compliance alert. Set is_resolved to true after the alert has been addressed. Set is_declined to true when the alert is declined; a declined alert remains unresolved. Only the status fields are intended for updates. Some users may be restricted to changing only the resolution status, and an alert cannot be resolved if it is already declined or otherwise not eligible for resolution.

Authorizations:
1.0.0_authenticatedSession
path Parameters
id
required
integer <int64>

Numeric identifier of the compliance alert.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
non-empty
is_resolved
boolean

Set to true when the alert has been addressed.

is_declined
boolean

Set to true when the alert is declined.

Responses

Production API endpoint

https://api.example.gov/api/v1/compliance-alerts/{id}/

Validation

Validation execution and validation failure resources.

Run validations for a parent object

Runs validation rules for the supplied parent object. If changed is omitted or empty, all applicable validations are run. If changed contains dotted paths, only affected validation failures are cleared and the validation engine is run with those paths. The response contains the currently displayed validation failure fields for the parent object in a DRF page-number pagination envelope.

Authorizations:
1.0.0_sessionCookie
query Parameters
page
integer >= 1
Default: 1

One-based page number. The endpoint uses DRF PageNumberPagination.

header Parameters
X-CSRFToken
string

Anti-CSRF security token required for session-authenticated requests that change data.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
parent_object_id
required
integer <int64> >= 1
parent_object_model
required
string non-empty

Content-type model identifier in app_label.ModelName form.

changed
Array of strings
Default: []

Dotted paths that changed and should be revalidated.

property name*
additional property
any

Responses

TBD deployment URL; replace with the environment-specific lender-experience API host.

https://developer.sba.gov/origination/api/v1/api/v1/validation/validate/

List displayed validation failure fields

Returns displayed validation failure fields visible to the requested parent object. parent_object_id and parent_object_model are required by the view. When the permission function denies access, the endpoint intentionally returns an empty paginated result rather than an error. Filtering by dismissal state is also supported.

Authorizations:
1.0.0_sessionCookie
query Parameters
parent_object_id
required

parent_object_model
required
string non-empty
Example: parent_object_model=lx_src.LoanApp

Content-type model identifier in app_label.ModelName form.

is_dismissed
boolean

Filter fields whose parent validation failure is dismissed.

page
integer >= 1
Default: 1

One-based page number. The endpoint uses DRF PageNumberPagination.
